name: RC-B10-0394/2026 – § 7 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text: 7. Reiterates its call to activate the human rights clause of the Political Dialogue and Cooperation Agreement and immediately suspend the agreement in the absence of concrete, verifiable steps by the regime towards multiparty democracy and the release of all political prisoners; emphasises that failure to suspend the Political Dialogue and Cooperation Agreement means that the EU is violating a legal clause contained in one of its signed agreements;
